Messages.Author: spinney99
Messages.Body:
so i couldn't find anywhere this has been asked... is Special Report
a special exception to the normal blocking rules like superior Eagle's
Sight? though there is no extra explanatory text, it seems to be that
way just by its actual text, and by the fact that it's a master.

------------------------

Special Report
====
Type(s): Master

Card Text:

Master: out-of-turn
Choose a ready vampire you control. That vampire untaps and attempts
to block. Once this action you may burn 1 pool to give that vampire +1
intercept.
------------------------

eg, my prey is about to bleed out my grandprey. it is not my turn. i
play the out-of-turn master Special Report, targeting a ready vampire
i control (the only requirement?) grendel is named. by text, he
"attempts to block" as a _result_ of being targeted by the Special
Report. it isn't a choice. it doesn't say "choose a ready vampire
you control who is a legal blocker for this action." is this
rule-overriding card text or not? sure seems like it to me, but i'm
eager to hear the official take on it.
(also, the recipient need not be tapped, right? you just untap them
as part of the card's result, so if already untapped, their
tapped/untapped status doesn't change?)

raving and drooling,
sporepickle

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 17 Nov 2002 10:34:02 -0800, spore...@hotmail.com (spinney99)
wrote:

>so i couldn't find anywhere this has been asked... is Special Report
>a special exception to the normal blocking rules like superior Eagle's
>Sight?

No.

You cannot play cards that require you to attempt to block if you are
not eligible to block the action.

FAQ 3.31
http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

3.31 Can I use a card that requires me to block, to untap against an
action that is not directed at me?

No.

Cards which require a block attempt as part of their untap effect (2nd
Tradition, Eternal Vigilance, Speak with Spirits) cannot be played if
your vampires cannot block the action. If you want to block an action
that is not directed at you, you must first play an Eagle's Sight or
Falcon's Eye before playing a card that untaps you and requires you to
block. In other words, you would first have to play a Wake with
Evening's Freshness or Forced Awakening, then play the Eagle's Sight
or Falcon's Eye to gain the ability to block, then you could use the
untap and block cards.

Special Report can be (and will be) added to this list as it requires
the minion to make a block attempt.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
